name: Valverde del Majano (Spain)
description: Square green flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valverde del Majano (a saint on yellow and the aqueduct on red above waves).
history: The flag of Valverde del Majano was approved officially on 2 March 1999 and the arms published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 24 July 2000; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, green, with the municipal arms at the centre.
